**In one line**: Anthropic says its Claude chatbot is taking on a meaningful portion of the work needed to build the company's next-generation model.

### Key points
- According to The Washington Post, Anthropic said Claude is increasingly involved in the engineering that goes into developing its successor model.
- The company reportedly described AI moving beyond assistance to handling substantive tasks such as writing code and running experiments.
- The account is being read as a concrete example of the debate over "recursive self-improvement," where an AI helps create its own next version.

### Why it matters
Having AI build the next AI could accelerate development, but it also revives questions about safety and controllability. A frontier lab stating this publicly is a notable signal of how model development itself may be shifting.
